production_goal: Replace prototype primitive readability with real production assets while preserving current runtime-car gates.
promotion_rules: Textures: PNG/TGA only; channel-pack where appropriate.
Every external file needs provider, exact source, license state and receipt/SHA256 before promotion.
No named hero likeness is promoted from a generic base mesh.
World static FBX may enter generic production importer only after source/QC preparation.
Character FBX must pass dedicated skeletal provenance/skeleton/deformation QC.
Repeated environment families use HISM/ISM, LOD and culling.
Heavy runtime assets remain soft-referenced and asynchronously loaded.
No future chapter runtime activation from this wave.
